bullets_en: What nonsense? KTR slams Revanth over Ram vs Shiva comment.

bullets_ur: Kya bakwas hai? KTR ne Revanth ko Ram vs Shiva comment par kharij kharij suna di.
Nalgonda mein MLA intikhabat par siyasi garmi barh gayi.
Keralam ke Kottayam mein Pala municipality mein muzahmati council meeting mein khalal.
